safety_warning_2: For your safety, please read all instructions in this manual before using this electrical appliance and always follow these safety precautions:
safety_warning_4: This product is for household use only. Do not use for any unintended purpose.
safety_warning_5: Do not allow children to play with this product or its power cord. Children and persons with limited mobility or cognitive ability should use it under adult supervision.
safety_warning_6: Small parts may pose a choking hazard. Keep away from children.
safety_warning_7: Do not use this product in high-humidity or high-temperature environments. Never use in the presence of flammable or explosive gases.
safety_warning_8: Ensure the power supply voltage matches the rating on the product nameplate.
safety_warning_10: When unplugging, grip the plug itself — do not pull the power cord.
safety_warning_11: Do not immerse the unit or power cord in water or any other liquid.
safety_warning_12: The power cord must be plugged directly into a properly rated electrical outlet.
safety_warning_13: If the plug, power cord, or unit is damaged, stop using it immediately and contact the manufacturer or an authorized service center. Do not attempt self-repair.
safety_warning_14: Do not let the power cord hang over the edge of a counter — children may pull it, causing tipping or injury.
safety_warning_15: Never touch the product's electrical components with wet hands or bare feet.
safety_warning_16: The power supply connected to this product must have a residual-current device (RCD/GFCI).
safety_warning_17: The outlet must comply with local regulations. Safety regulations require mandatory grounding of this product.
safety_warning_18: Before cleaning, maintenance, or replacing parts, always disconnect the power supply.
safety_warning_19: Never insert screwdrivers or other objects into the ventilation openings.
safety_warning_20: Only authorized technicians may disassemble, inspect, or repair this product.
safety_warning_21: In case of fire, do not use water — use a CO₂ fire extinguisher.
safety_warning_22: Do not use mechanical means or any method other than those recommended by the manufacturer to accelerate defrosting.
safety_warning_23: Do not damage the refrigerant circuit.
safety_warning_24: Warning: Flammable materials — risk of fire.
safety_warning_25: Refrigerant waste must be disposed of at an authorized waste processing center. Keep away from open flames.
safety_warning_26: Do not store aerosol cans or other explosive substances containing flammable propellants inside this product.
safety_warning_27: Keep all ventilation openings clear. Keep the product away from heat sources or steam-generating appliances.

safety_caution_6: Wear gloves when servicing the motor or internal refrigeration system.
safety_caution_7: Do not block the ventilation openings to ensure proper operation.
safety_caution_8: Do not place non-food items inside the product chamber.
safety_caution_9: This product is for indoor use only.
safety_caution_10: This product is designed to make ice from drinking water. Do not use it for any other purpose.
